name: GQ-006 · The Information Organ
summary: A standing research and systems question about making broad, continuously refreshed evidence reliably accessible to every authorized agent workflow.

research_contract.question: How should the information organ continuously gather, preserve, query, and push valuable evidence into authorized agent workflows and self-improvement loops?
source_scopes: Library Research Works and their public contracts
research_contract.answer_shape: A verified operating architecture with explicit ownership, freshness contracts, query primitives, feedback loops, failure modes, and observed end-to-end receipts.
research_contract.refresh_policy: Re-answer when a source lane, retrieval contract, or learning loop materially changes or fails its freshness guarantee.
success_criteria: Freshness is derived from observable state, never asserted by whoever last touched the record. A ledger entry that says 'fresh' must be checkable against the repository.
Every number the organ publishes can be re-derived mechanically from a named source by a second program that did not produce it.
Evidence attaches to a question by reference — byte ranges into sources — rather than by copying corpora into the registry.
A delivery path that stops working becomes visible without anyone remembering to check it.
falsifiers: A published number cannot be re-derived from its named source, and the disagreement is invisible until a human notices. This has fired repeatedly: a hyphen/underscore path typo reported 0 source inventories when 6 existed, because the builder and the checker shared the wrong path.

The freshness mechanism produces so many false positives that its output is routinely dismissed — a gate that cries wolf is worse than no gate. This fired once: hardening a verifier marked all 10 claims stale at once.
Maintaining the organ costs more attention than the decisions it improves.

The organ reports a pipeline as healthy while that pipeline has never actually run end to end. This fired on 2026-08-04: outbox/sent/ was empty — zero escalations ever delivered — while the queue was reported as merely 'queued'.
watch_triggers: A gate is added, narrowed, or disabled — each changes what the organ can detect and can silently reduce coverage.
A derivation's named source moves or is renamed, which makes file-count silently return 0 rather than error.
Any delivery or ingestion path reports success without a receipt proving the far end received something.
A published surface begins carrying a hardcoded value where it previously carried a measured one.
evidence_gaps: Escalation delivery is automated but still unproven end to end: zero messages have been delivered because the peer has been offline the whole time. The drain is verified to run and no-op correctly; it has never been verified to succeed.
No independent reviewer has checked any claim. Eight claims await review, and self-review cannot satisfy the criterion that a second party can re-derive the numbers.
Push freshness into agent workflows is named in the question but unbuilt: the organ currently publishes and waits to be read rather than pushing into a loop.
research_contract.decision_to_change: Whether to trust a published Library number without re-deriving it, and whether an evidence path is sound enough to attach to a standing question.
research_contract.state_note: Contract written 2026-08-04. Three of the four falsifiers have already fired at least once and are recorded with what fired them, so this contract is a record of observed failure modes rather than anticipated ones.

evidence.summary: The existing answer receipts were read; machine state, private topology, and operational details remain outside the public Library.
